extracted.intended_audience: romance authors (agented or unagented) seeking to submit completed manuscripts to the Forever Yours imprint (Hachette Book Group)
extracted.subtask_short: romance novel submission to Forever Yours
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting completed romance novels or novellas to the Forever Yours digital imprint, including preferred genres, manuscript requirements, submission format, and contractual/royalty terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercially compelling storytelling / voice & characterization
rubrics_metrics.description: "Fantastic writers who tell a story we can’t put down, characters that captivate us, and if you can make us blush, laugh out loud, or shed a tear—even better."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on page-turning plots and emotionally engaging characters; emotional reactions (blush, laugh, cry) are explicitly desirable qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred genres / styles
rubrics_metrics.description: "We’re interested in all styles of romance, particularly contemporary, diverse reads, romantic suspense, cowboys, historicals, and paranormal."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submission should fit within these romance subgenres; diversity in content is highlighted as desirable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: "We’re not looking for any YA, fantasy, mystery, general fiction, or nonfiction."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit works in these excluded categories; submissions outside romance subgenres listed above will be rejected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word count requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Novels should be between 50,000-100,000 words. Novellas should be 25,000-50,000 words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to these length ranges for the appropriate format (novel vs novella); works over 50,000 words may also qualify for a print-on-demand edition (see separate entry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent status accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Forever Yours accepts both agented and unagented submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No agent required; both represented and self-submitted manuscripts will be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method & contact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submissions must be sent via email to this address; follow the required contents listed below in email body and attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query letter requirements (email body)
rubrics_metrics.description: - In the body of the email: a query letter that includes the main hook of your story, the genre, the word count, a brief summary, and a little bit about you
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The email body must contain these elements; make the main hook and concise author info clear and present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synopsis requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: - A detailed 3-5 page synopsis as an attachment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a detailed multi-page synopsis (3–5 pages) that outlines plot and resolution; do not rely on a one-paragraph synopsis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript format & completion requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: - Your completed manuscript saved as a Word doc. Forever Yours will only consider manuscripts that are complete at the time of submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the full, finished manuscript in Microsoft Word format; partial or incomplete manuscripts will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement and response time
rubrics_metrics.description: Once your submission has been received, you will be sent an auto-response confirming receipt of submission. Please allow up to 8 weeks for our editorial team to respond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect an automated receipt, and allow up to eight weeks before follow-up; do not query earlier than this timeframe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejection data-handling policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If your submission is not right for our list, you will be contacted and the file will be permanently deleted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Files for rejected submissions will be deleted after notification; authors should retain their own copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Next steps if interested / contract
rubrics_metrics.description: If we are interested in discussing your submission for the Forever Yours list, you will be contacted and will be asked to enter into a written publishing agreement governing publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interest will be followed by direct contact and a formal written publishing agreement; no publication occurs without a contract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital-first production benefits / editorial experimentation
rubrics_metrics.description: "With a digital production schedule, we can publish works more quickly, and experiment with stories and genres that haven’t yet broken out in the print marketplace."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forever Yours positions itself to move quickly and take chances on emerging or niche romance subgenres due to digital-first model.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing package / services provided
rubrics_metrics.description: Forever Yours offers a complete publishing package: editing by Forever editors, top-notch cover design from the Forever art team, a dedicated publicist, Netgalley review copies for bloggers/reviewers, social media tools, social media marketing, and an experienced digital sales team with long-standing relationships in the e-marketplace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors accepted receive editorial, design, publicity, review copies, marketing tools, and digital-sales support as part of the imprint's standard package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print-on-demand availability for longer works
rubrics_metrics.description: For works over 50,000 words, there will be a print-on-demand edition available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although Forever Yours is digital-focused, qualifying longer works (over 50k) may have a POD print option.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ebook royalties and advance policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Ebook royalties are 50% of net receipts, and royalties are accounted quarterly. There is no advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors receive 50% of net ebook revenue, paid quarterly; do not expect an upfront advance payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution / retail availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Forever Yours titles are available at all major e-retailers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted books will be distributed broadly through major e-retailer channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital rights management / piracy protection
rubrics_metrics.description: All of Forever Yours titles will be DRM protected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Titles will use DRM to deter piracy; authors should be aware of this rights/protection approach.
